model.file_sha256_source: Shard values are the Git LFS oids the Hub API lists for this revision; the other files were hashed locally and their Git blob ids match the Hub tree of this revision.

precision.cast: Load the published float32 weights unquantized, then cast every floating parameter to bfloat16 with mlx.nn.Module.set_dtype before the first call. Image tensors follow the patch-embedding dtype inside mlx-vlm. No quantization.
precision.reason: bfloat16 is the precision used by the model card's own inference examples and the text_config torch_dtype.

chat_template.source: chat_template.json of the pinned revision, unmodified
chat_template.message: one user message whose content is six {"type": "image"} items in the frozen frame order followed by one {"type": "text"} item holding the frozen prompt text; add_generation_prompt=true; no system message; no conversation history

image_processing.processor: SmolVLMImageProcessor from preprocessor_config.json of the pinned revision, loaded by mlx-vlm 0.8.0 (use_fast=false)
image_processing.unchanged: every other preprocessor_config.json value: do_convert_rgb, do_resize with resample 1, do_rescale 1/255, do_normalize mean 0.5 std 0.5, do_pad, max_image_size longest_edge 384
image_processing.effect: each 448 x 448 frozen frame becomes one 384 x 384 tile of 81 image tokens; six images give 486 image tokens
image_processing.reason: With the stored default do_image_splitting=true each 448 x 448 frame is upscaled to 1536 and split into 16 tiles plus a global tile (1377 tokens per image). Measured before freezing on six synthetic 448 x 448 images with the 66 frozen prompt texts, the prompts would be 8769-8791 tokens, above max_position_embeddings 8192 of the text model. Without splitting they are 777-799 tokens. The checkpoint's own video_sampling setting also feeds frames at longest_edge 384 without splitting.

decoding.sampling: greedy argmax (mlx-vlm temperature 0); top_p, top_k, min_p, repetition penalty left unset
decoding.stop: tokenizer eos <end_of_utterance> (id 49279, equal to generation_config.json eos_token_id) or the 64-token budget
decoding.context: fresh context per call; calls run one at a time in calls.jsonl run_order

runtime.device: Apple M3 Pro, Metal GPU; the same Python environment as the #11 run
